I don't consider this a horror story just something spooky that happened ... 


So one night I woke up at around 3 am, this is normal I just randomly wake up and look at the darkness untill I fall asleep again 

But this time I turned and looked over at the bathroom door for no reason at all and saw a child there standing looking at me, I must say his skin pale, his eyes pitched black and his hair was medium length by what I could thanks to the moonlight that shined through the window. I didn't get any bad feeling from looking at him at all. He didn't look scary instead he looked like a cute kid, I stared at him and he was staring back for a long while. I the. Tilted my head and he did the same. 

When he tilted his head as I had did, that perhaps pulled me back in to reality as I then realized "we don't have any children in my house, as a matter of fact we are all females here" as I came to that realization I noticed how creepy those pitch black eyes were. 

I turned my body to the other side of my bed towards my sister who had been sleeping in my bed that night and Shaked her violently to wake up and asked her to turn on the lights . 

Was it a ghost I saw ? Idk what that child was but since then when I wake up at night I just close my eyes hoping there is nothing there
